title: Boku no Hero Academia: UA Heroes Battle
content:
One shot episode on the steps of that one Adventure Time episode where Finn and Jake play that augmented reality card game. The concept has always looked so cool to me, it combines board game fun and digital convenience in a perfect formula.

Now, with this episode, the same concept is brought up, but with a more familiar and wide cast of characters. Although, many inconveniences naturally come when powerscalling is at stake. It turns a seemingly fun game into a toxic discourse filled box of misfortune, especially when Bakugo is involved.

One thing that threw me off though is the weird alien eyes all the cardcharacters had. Very eery and disturbing a an uncanny way.

Overall: 6.96/10.
